assertions: At each 10,000-step interval, checkpoint encoding stays within the 65,536-byte limit and decoding preserves the complete snapshot, including the SHA-256 state hash.
Restored worlds continue at the expected tick with population 256 and balanced matter and energy ledgers.
The run reaches tick 100,000 with terminal reason MAX_STEPS_REACHED and rejects an additional step.
A separate spatial test verifies food-driven movement, local feeding and waste, the 64-cell habitat, and the matter ledger.
scope_limit: This evidence covers deterministic in-memory ecology/4 checkpoints. It does not exercise Paper/Folia player PDC writes, repeated server save cycles, process crashes, or human usability.
